# Copilot Instructions for 7heknight (GitHub Profile README)

## Repository Purpose
This is a **GitHub profile README** repository (`7heknight/7heknight`). The sole deliverable is `README.md`, which renders as the landing page on [github.com/7heknight](https://github.com/7heknight).

## Architecture & Key Components
- **`README.md`**: Profile page using raw HTML inside Markdown; references locally-committed SVG stats images and social badge links
- **`.github/workflows/metrics.yml`**: GitHub Actions workflow (daily cron + manual trigger) that uses `lowlighter/metrics` to generate `github-metrics.svg` and `github-languages.svg` in the repo root
- **`github-metrics.svg` / `github-languages.svg`**: Auto-generated stat cards committed by the workflow — served via `raw.githubusercontent.com`

## Content Structure in `README.md`
Sections appear in this order. Each section title is an `<h3 align="center">`.
- **Header**: Animated typing SVG via `readme-typing-svg.demolab.com` (role lines, not greetings only), followed by a two-line bio
- **Focus Areas**: 2-column HTML table, one cell per domain (mobile, web/API, Windows/red team, cloud, vulnerability research, binary exploitation)
- **Toolbox**: Table of `flat-square` badges (`161b22` background, `58a6ff` logo) grouped by category
- **Featured Projects**: 2-column table linking public repositories only
- **Selected Research**: Table linking blog write-ups on `7heknight.github.io` (URL pattern `/<category>/<slug>/`, categories `pentest`, `redteam`, `writeups`)
- **GitHub Activity**: Metrics card, languages card (both locally committed SVGs from `lowlighter/metrics`), then the streak card from `streak-stats.demolab.com`; each image sits in its own `<kbd>` wrapper
- **Connect**: Shields.io `for-the-badge` links (Blog, LinkedIn, Facebook), then a one-line authorized-testing disclaimer

## Project-Specific Patterns & Conventions
- All layout uses raw HTML (`<p>`, `<h3>`, `<table>`, `<kbd>`, `<a>`, `<img>`) rather than native Markdown — preserve this pattern when editing
- Content must be verifiable: describe only work that exists in public repositories or on the public blog, and write "analysis" for CVE write-ups unless the work is an original discovery. Do not link or describe private repositories
- Do not add a profile-views counter or other hit counters; they add third-party requests and no signal
- Never set both `width` and `height` on the lowlighter SVGs; they are 960px wide natively and fixed dimensions distort the text. Set `width="800"` only
- Stats SVGs are generated by `lowlighter/metrics` via `.github/workflows/metrics.yml` — theming is controlled via `extras_css` in the workflow YAML, using `#58a6ff` as the primary color
- Color values passed to `plugin_languages_colors` need a leading `#` (`0:#58a6ff`); without it the output has `fill="58a6ff"`, which renders black
- Social badges use `img.shields.io` with `style=for-the-badge` and colored backgrounds (e.g., `Facebook-1877F2`) — follow this pattern for any new links
- Username reference is `7heknight` (lowercase 'h') everywhere in URLs

## Notes for AI Agents
- **Stats generation**: `.github/workflows/metrics.yml` runs daily at midnight UTC and on push to `main`. Requires a `METRICS_TOKEN` secret (GitHub PAT with `repo` scope) in the repo settings
- **Manual refresh**: Trigger the "GitHub Metrics" workflow manually via Actions tab to regenerate SVGs on demand
- When adding new metrics plugins, add them as a new step in the workflow YAML using `lowlighter/metrics@latest` and commit the output SVG filename
- Streak stats use these params: `background=00000000&ring=58a6ff&fire=58a6ff&currStreakLabel=58a6ff&sideLabels=58a6ff&currStreakNum=58a6ff&sideNums=58a6ff&dates=8b949e&hide_border=true`
- Typing SVG uses `color=58A6FF` (uppercase hex) and `font=Fira+Code` — keep font/color consistent if editing
- GitHub renders profile READMEs with limited HTML support — avoid `<style>`, `<script>`, `<iframe>`, or CSS classes (they are stripped)
- The `<kbd>` tag around stats images adds a subtle border effect — this is intentional styling
- Keep the file concise; GitHub truncates long profile READMEs with a "Read more" fold
